summary: The `LeftNavigation` module in the HSPnet framework is responsible for building and managing the left-hand navigation within the application. It manages various menus and navigation elements, customizing visibility and functionality based on the user's session and role.
purpose: The purpose of the LeftNavigation module is to construct and manage the dynamic behavior of the left navigation panel, providing a contextual navigation experience tailored to user roles and permissions.

workflows.name: BuildLeftNavigation
steps: Set up version tag and welcome panels.
Conditionally render cohort, person, inbox, and outbox panels.
Construct worksheet, content, reporting, maintenance, and help menus.
Evaluate and set the visibility of each panel and menu item.
Highlight the current selection where applicable.

business_rules: Specific panels and hyperlinks are visible or hidden based on user roles.
Highlighting of current page or node is dynamic based on the requested page.
The navigation menu adapts to the user's session configuration, such as language and role.
validations: Ensure URL hashes are added for navigation links.
Confirm current page special cases to highlight appropriate links.
conditions: Panel visibility is conditioned on user roles like StudentMaintOnly or SystemDataAdministrator.
Navigation elements are conditionally rendered based on session attributes like UseAgreements.
system_behavior: Adjust menu styles based on session attributes.
Alter navigation element actions based on role-based conditions.
dependencies: Resources for various sections (Agencies, Governing Orgs, etc.)
Session attributes for role determination and visibility logic.
URL hashing and query string additions for secure navigation.
